subject: general
question: ________ was sworn in as Central Vigilance Commissioner on 29 May 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Praveen Kumar Srivastava**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praveen Kumar Srivastava** was sworn in as Central Vigilance Commissioner on 29 May 2023.
 
• The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) is an apex Indian governmental body created in 1964 to address governmental corruption.
 
• It has the status of an autonomous body, free of control from any executive authority, charged with monitoring all vigilance activities under the Central Government of India.
 
• The CVC advises various authorities in central government organizations in planning, executing, reviewing, and reforming their vigilance work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Central Vigilance Commission was established on the recommendations of the Committee on Prevention of Corruption, headed by Shri K. Santhanam.
 
• The CVC is not controlled by any Ministry or Department. It is an independent body which is only responsible to the Parliament.
 
• The tenure of the Central Vigilance Commissioner is four years or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
 
• The CVC can have a Central Vigilance Commissioner and not more than two Vigilance Commissioners.
